_note: Prices per million tokens for each model deployment name the agents record. They are Azure's GBP retail prices for Global Standard in UK South (gpt-4o version 2024-11-20, gpt-4.1 version 2025-04-14), from the Azure Retail Prices API on 2026-10-26, which publishes them per 1,000 tokens to four decimal places.
